meta.name: add-vercel
meta.description: Add Vercel deployment capability to NanoClaw agents. Installs the Vercel CLI in agent containers and sets up OneCLI credential injection for api.vercel.com. Use when the user wants agents to deploy web applications to Vercel.

copy.tagline: 让智能体把网站部署到 Vercel
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你想用智能体自动部署网站到 Vercel
copy.tagline_en: Let your agent deploy websites to Vercel
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want your agent to automatically deploy websites to Vercel

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 代理的工作容器里会装好 Vercel 命令行工具,OneCLI 会把 Vercel 密钥自动注入到请求;代理能直接执行 vercel deploy、vercel ls 等命令,把网页应用部署到 Vercel。
howto.when: 当用户要求让代理把网页应用部署到 Vercel 时触发;也可以直接执行 /add-vercel 启动这套安装流程。

say.text: 请帮我把当前项目部署到 Vercel 生产环境。
查看我在 Vercel 上的部署列表。
say.note: 代理会运行 vercel ls 拉取列表。

say.text: 帮我确认 Vercel 的登录身份。
say.note: 代理会运行 vercel whoami 验证凭据。

howto.what_en: Turns NanoClaw agent containers into Vercel deployers: it installs the Vercel CLI, configures OneCLI to inject the Vercel API token for api.vercel.com, and lets the agent run commands like vercel deploy/ls/whoami to ship web apps.
howto.when_en: Triggers when the user asks agents to deploy web applications to Vercel. It can also be started by running /add-vercel to set up the capability.

say_en.text: Please deploy this project to Vercel production.
Check whether I'm logged in to Vercel.
